cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Asset-light, outsourced manufacturing model with a stated intent to backward-integrate into in-house production. Inbound: the Company maintains a procurement network for gold and silver from RBI-registered bullion banks, independent bullion dealers, imports through the India International Bullion Exchange and exchange of metal from customers; gemstones (rubies, pearls, flat diamonds, emeralds) are procured from Jaipur, Surat, Mumbai, Hyderabad and Thailand. Gold bullion is 86.04% of total purchases in Fiscal 2026 (94.65% in Fiscal 2025, 94.92% in Fiscal 2024). Design is in-house: 15 designers as of July 31, 2026, supported by market research and trend analysis; the Company added 6 SKUs and 1 product category in Fiscal 2026 (9 SKUs / 2 categories in Fiscal 2025, 3 SKUs / 1 category in Fiscal 2024). Manufacturing is entirely outsourced: raw material is supplied to a network of 41 karigars (formal agreements with 29; 25 associated more than 5 years), primarily in Telangana and Maharashtra, who craft, polish and finish ornaments and return them against making charges - the RHP notes this avoids significant capital investment while providing flexibility and scalability. Job work is the mirror arrangement: customers supply raw material, the Company processes it for a fee without taking ownership. Downstream: finished pieces go to government-registered, BIS-approved hallmarking centres for purity certification, then through an in-house quality-control team checking purity, structural integrity, design accuracy, stone quality, stone setting, design symmetry and finishing, then billing, packing and dispatch via in-house delivery executives or third-party logistics for inter-city delivery. Orders arrive by e-mail, the Company's third-party mobile application 'Deepa Jewellers Limited' (commissioned June 25, 2021; 312 / 152 / 110 users in Fiscal 2026 / 2025 / 2024, B2B use only, design-selection interface only) and social media; sales are either from ready-stock inventory or order-based from the design bank. Forward integration into retail is absent - the Company owns no standalone stores and does not sell to end consumers. The planned backward integration is the 6,696 sq ft Proposed Facility in Hyderabad (real wax 3D printer ProJet MJP 300W, vacuum pressure casting machine, induction melting furnace), expected operational before the end of the first half of Fiscal 2027, intended to reduce karigar dependence, lower making charges, improve quality control, limit pilferage and protect design confidentiality; it had not commenced commercial operations as on the date of the RHP. Working capital is short-cycle: inventory holding 18 / 21 / 22 days, debtors 36 / 29 / 32 days, creditors 1 / 1 / 1 day, net operating cycle 53 / 49 / 53 days for Fiscal 2026 / 2025 / 2024. Gold price exposure is managed through hedging instruments of varying tenures.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- Significant revenue contribution from Southern India - the region with the highest jewellery consumption share in India (38-43%); South Indian states contributed 94.37% of FY2026 revenue from operations, with consistent year-on-year growth in every state of operation
- Well established customer base with long-standing relationships with jewellery retail chains and standalone stores - 373 customers as of July 31, 2026, of which 18 have been associated since inception, 36 for over 7 years and 86 for 5-7 years; named customers include Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, Lalithaa Jewellery Mart, Chandana …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Customer 1 alone was 16.80% of FY2026 revenue; names are withheld as commercially sensitive. There are no long-term commitments, so any customer reducing or terminating business would hit revenue directly. The RHP confirms none of the top customers are related or promoter-linked parties.
- Gold is procured on purchase orders with no long-term contracts from an RBI-registered bullion bank, independent bullion dealers, IIBX imports and customer exchanges; adverse regulatory change (including RBI limits on gold loans) or supplier non-performance would disrupt input supply and pricing.
- Engagement is non-exclusive; competitors can bid karigars away, karigars sub-delegate work affecting quality, and they gain access to proprietary designs. The Company registers no designs under the Designs Act, 2000, so design leakage is difficult to enforce against.
- Regional economic downturns, shifts in consumer behaviour, natural disasters, infrastructure failure or state policy change would hit almost the entire revenue base at once.
- Inventory is gold, so the balance sheet is directly levered to gold prices; hedging through gold metal loans, futures and an internal policy does not cover 100.00% of inventory. Negative operating cash flows have been experienced in prior periods.
- Both are culturally specific South Indian bridal and daily-wear categories; a shift in design preference (the RHP itself flags rising demand for minimalist jewellery) would hit the core range.
- The RHP flags approval, machinery availability, installation, construction, logistics and labour risks that could delay commissioning and cause cost overruns, and the transition from outsourced to in-house manufacturing brings new operational, managerial and financial risk.
- Promoters will retain majority control after the Offer and can influence all shareholder matters. Unsecured loans from Promoters are repayable on demand subject to Yes Bank consent, and two erstwhile Promoter Group partnership firms (M/s Deepa Jewellers and M/s Deepa Gold) were dissolved shortly before filing, leaving possible residual tax or regulatory liabilities.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Commission the Proposed Facility, a 6,696.00 square foot first in-house manufacturing facility in Basheerbagh, Hyderabad equipped with a real-wax 3D printer (ProJet MJP 300W), vacuum pressure casting machine and induction melting furnace, …**
- **Open an additional sales office in Bengaluru in Fiscal 2027 to strengthen physical presence across South India, adding to the Vijayawada office opened in November 2025.**
- **Add 22 additional SKUs to the product portfolio by Fiscal 2027, from 110 SKUs as of July 31, 2026.**
- **Add 2 new product categories by Fiscal 2027, from 16 products as of July 31, 2026, focused on higher-margin lines including paper casting jewellery and nakshi kundan jewellery.**
- **Increase the in-house design team from 15 to 20 employees to introduce new SKUs and product categories at a faster pace and support more frequent product refresh cycles.**
- **Expand the marketing team from 12 to 25 members and increase participation in regional and national trade exhibitions to deepen customer engagement.**
- **Deploy Rs 2,150.00 million of the Fresh Issue Net Proceeds towards funding long-term working capital requirements for procurement, maintenance and scaling up of inventory, phased Rs 1,250.00 million in Fiscal 2027 and Rs 900.00 million in …**
- **Reduce dependence on karigars for jewellery manufacturing and lower the making charges currently paid to them by shifting a higher proportion of production in-house through the Proposed Facility.**
- **Implement a comprehensive gold-wastage minimisation framework across manufacturing operations, including specialised filtration, extraction and dust-collection systems, dedicated recovery stations and high-efficiency vacuum systems, with …**
- **Deploy technology-enabled inventory management to optimise stock levels and reduce working capital requirements, and a technology-driven order management system covering the end-to-end order lifecycle from receipt to fulfilment.**
- **Retain future earnings for operations and expansion under the dividend policy adopted on November 28, 2025; the Company states it may not declare a dividend in the foreseeable future.**
- **Management flags continued reliance on its top 10 customers, who were 64.67% of FY2026 revenue from operations, and expects that reliance to persist for the foreseeable future - a concentration a post-listing quarter can track.**
